title: KCES v0.1 vertical slice: epoch-bound maintenance validation
objective: Demonstrate the complete governed loop end to end in isolation: research cards -> preregistered experiment -> deterministic AutoAudit -> promotion decisions under calibration policy -> evidence and rollback, with Mission Control events written to an outbox.
system_boundary: This experiment folder plus the sibling QF-001 import folder inside jules-playground. No network calls, no other repositories, no ledger writes, no runtime mutation anywhere.
primary_metric: Loop completeness: every stage emits a schema-valid record and the deterministic audit passes with zero failed checks.
measurement_map: autoaudit/run-autoaudit.mjs evidence array; sipr-experiment/results.json for the embedded SIPR-EXP-001 metric (canonical-hash ops/sec).
baseline: No governed loop exists; changes flow through ad-hoc agent sessions with manual review only.
intervention: Introduce contracts, evaluator registry, deterministic audit, and dry-run promotion policy as executable artifacts.
expected_recovery_behavior: Not applicable at slice level; defined inside SIPR-EXP-001 (JIT warm-up windows).
plateau_window: Not applicable at slice level; defined inside SIPR-EXP-001 (5 steady windows).

controls.description: SIPR-EXP-001 negative control: baseline relabeled as intervention, expected gain within ±10%.
SIPR-EXP-001 reversed control: pessimized variant, expected strictly negative gain.

confounds: Single-container measurements; CPU contention; builder-authored audit (mitigated by auditor_is_builder flag blocking self-promotion).
failure_condition: Any deterministic audit check fails, any record fails schema validation, or any promotion decision violates the R3/calibration invariants.
rollback_condition: Close the draft pull request and delete the branch; the experiment folder is self-contained and deletable with no external state.
replication_requirement: SIPR-EXP-001: 3 replications with agreeing sign. Slice level: audit re-run must reproduce the same verdict on the same commit.

provenance.source: Superseding maintenance manifest for reviewed epoch-binding audit. Historical manifest archived at manifests/2026-07-16-a.MANIFEST.json; original experiment outcomes and claim thresholds remain historical.
